title: Bill Hartline foam topper pallets on scale weight
text: Hartline launched a private-label mattress topper line and ships the foam toppers LTL from Tacoma to their stores. Their logistics manager says we bill the pallets at a weight they never weigh: a 48x40x72 pallet that scales at 310 lb is billed at 480 lb, so they pay about 55% more than they expected per pallet. They want the foam toppers billed on actual scale weight like their other freight. Example: PRO 7731-0442, one pallet, 310 lb on the scale, should bill 310 lb. This comes from `billable_weight` in `billing_weight.py`. They are asking for it before the holiday reset, when volume on this line triples.
